svg.title: What fills a passage's memory: the full pack against names only
svg.desc: Left, names and facts: facts are 81 to 88% of the characters a passage is given, and the budget keeps old facts (median 9 to 12 chapters old) while cutting new ones (median 3 to 5); about 2,862 characters of memory per passage. Right, names only: 392 characters per passage. Inconsistent renderings: 11.3% with names and facts, 9.8% with names only. Judged character errors: 10 with names and facts, 8 with names only. Stage 2 (November 7): 60 unseen chapters, both packs with a 20-chapter lead-in.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif
